item.title: US military strikes another alleged drug boat in eastern Pacific, killing 3
item.description: The U.S. military said Friday that it has carried out another deadly strike on a vessel accused of trafficking drugs in the Eastern Pacific Ocean.

item.title: President Trump wants to impose 15% tariff, up from 10% he announced after Supreme Court decision
item.description: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he was raising the global tariff he wants to impose to 15%, up from 10% he had announced a day earlier.

item.title: SF businesses wonder what Supreme Court ruling means for them after Trump's tariffs struck down
item.description: After a landmark ruling, President Donald Trump's so-called reciprocal tariffs have officially been ruled illegal. Here's how San Francisco businesses are reacting.

item.title: Baseball Hall of Famer Bill Mazeroski, known for walk-off home run in 1960 World Series, dies at 89
item.description: Bill Mazeroski, the Hall of Fame second baseman who won eight Gold Glove awards and the hearts of Pittsburgh Pirates fans for his historic walk-off home run in Game 7 of the 1960 World Series, has died at the age of 89.

item.title: 'Jersey Shore' star Snooki says she has cervical cancer
item.description: Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi said Friday that she has cervical cancer.

item.title: Oakland's Olympic gold medalist Alysa Liu inspires young athletes at her local ice rink
item.description: Oakland's own Alysa Liu became the first U.S individual gold medal winner in women's figure skating in 24 years. Liu wowed the judges at the Winter Olympics on Thursday, but in the Bay Area, she has been stunning many at her local ice rink for decades.

item.title: Castle Peak avalanche: What we know about 6 moms among 9 skiers presumed dead
item.description: Six women killed in the Castle Peak avalanche were among a group of eight close friends and experienced backcountry skiers on a trip together, their families said in a statement Thursday.

item.title: California Democrats host annual convention in SF with hopes of endorsing candidate for governor
item.description: California Democrats are in San Francisco this weekend for the party's state convention. The gathering is about plans and strategies for the months ahead, including endorsing a candidate for governor.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Partly cloudy tomorrow afternoon; highs in 60s
item.description: There is a chance of rain for the North Bay and coastline Sunday morning, with milder lows in the 40s. There will be clouds and sun for the afternoon with a return to more widespread 60s for afternoon highs.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry as a partial government shutdown continues.
